scripts.dev-static: next build && cp .env.development static-apps/demo-exm-web-nextjs && cp ../../../tools/next-start-static.sh static-apps/demo-exm-web-nextjs && cd static-apps/demo-exm-web-nextjs && bash next-start-static.sh && npx serve -l 3000
scripts.release:local: pnpm build && cd ../../../ && bash build-script/container/release-next-app.sh demo-exm-web nextjs demo-exm-web-nextjs
scripts.release:static: pnpm build && cd ../../../ && bash build-script/static-site/release-next-static.sh demo-exm-web nextjs demo-exm-web-nextjs
scripts.release:containers: pnpm build && cd ../../../ && bash build-script/container/release-next-app.sh demo-exm-web nextjs demo-exm-web-nextjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:gen && pnpm run fix:lcov
scripts.docker:build: docker image prune -f && cd ../../../release && docker build -f container-apps/demo-exm-web/nextjs/Dockerfile -t demo-exm-web-nextjs .
scripts.docker:run: docker rm -f demo-exm-web-nextjs  && cd ../../../release && docker run -p 4001:3000 --env-file container-apps/demo-exm-web/nextjs/.env --name demo-exm-web-nextjs demo-exm-web-nextjs:latest
scripts.docker:remove: docker rm  -f -v demo-exm-web-nextjs && docker rmi demo-exm-web-nextjs
scripts.docker:artifact:build: docker image prune -f && cd ../../../release && docker build -f static-apps/Dockerfile.artifact-demo-exm-web-nextjs -t demo-exm-web-nextjs:$(git rev-parse HEAD) .
scripts.docker:artifact:restore: cd ../../../release && docker create --name artifact-demo-exm-web-nextjs demo-exm-web-nextjs:$(git rev-parse HEAD) && docker cp artifact-demo-exm-web-nextjs:/artifacts ./static-apps/demo-exm-web-nextjs && docker rm -f artifact-demo-exm-web-nextjs
